siteOptions.blogname: Bếp Đức — Demo (dữ liệu giả lập)

steps.code:
<?php
require_once '/wordpress/wp-load.php';
// Keep Playground setup independent of WP-CLI's WebAssembly process.
global $wp_rewrite;
$wp_rewrite->set_permalink_structure('/%postname%/');
flush_rewrite_rules(false);
foreach (['shop'=>'Shop','so-sanh'=>'So sánh','tu-van-chon-bep'=>'Tư vấn chọn bếp'] as $slug=>$title) {
  $page=get_page_by_path($slug, OBJECT, 'page');
  $id=$page ? $page->ID : wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>$title,'post_name'=>$slug],true);
  if (is_wp_error($id)) throw new RuntimeException($id->get_error_message());
  if ($slug==='shop') update_option('woocommerce_shop_page_id',$id);
}
$home=get_page_by_path('trang-chu',OBJECT,'page');
$home_id=$home ? $home->ID : wp_insert_post(['post_type'=>'page','post_status'=>'publish','post_title'=>'Trang chủ','post_name'=>'trang-chu'],true);
if(is_wp_error($home_id)) throw new RuntimeException($home_id->get_error_message());
update_option('show_on_front','page');
update_option('page_on_front',$home_id);
update_option('woocommerce_currency','VND');
// Lightweight synthetic preview: do not claim full WP-CLI manifest seed coverage.
if (!class_exists('WC_Product_Simple')) throw new RuntimeException('WooCommerce not active.');
if (!term_exists('bep-tu','product_cat')) wp_insert_term('Bếp từ DEMO','product_cat',['slug'=>'bep-tu']);
if (!term_exists('may-hut-mui','product_cat')) wp_insert_term('Máy hút mùi DEMO','product_cat',['slug'=>'may-hut-mui']);
$fixtures=[
 ['BD-PLAY-001','[DEMO] Bếp từ mẫu 60 cm','bep-tu','7990000'],
 ['BD-PLAY-002','[DEMO] Bếp từ mẫu 80 cm','bep-tu','12990000'],
 ['BD-PLAY-003','[DEMO] Máy hút mùi mẫu âm tủ','may-hut-mui','4990000'],
 ['BD-PLAY-004','[DEMO] Máy hút mùi mẫu kính cong','may-hut-mui','6990000'],
];
foreach($fixtures as [$sku,$name,$cat,$price]) {
  if (wc_get_product_id_by_sku($sku)) continue;
  $p=new WC_Product_Simple();
  $p->set_sku($sku);
  $p->set_name($name);
  $p->set_status('publish');
  $p->set_catalog_visibility('visible');
  $p->set_regular_price($price);
  $p->set_price($price);
  $p->set_manage_stock(true);
  $p->set_stock_quantity(10);
  $p->set_description('SẢN PHẨM DEMO. Dữ liệu giả lập chỉ dùng để xem giao diện.');
  $p->set_short_description('Hàng mẫu, không phải sản phẩm đang bán.');
  $term=get_term_by('slug',$cat,'product_cat');
  if($term) $p->set_category_ids([(int)$term->term_id]);
  $p->save();
}
